steps.content: Sand beasts and Corruptors crawl through the cracks in the barrier, wreaking havoc on the city's infrastructure. Screams, wails, and monstrous howls have replaced the bustling peace of daily life, transforming Furor into a battlefield in an instant.
The barrier overhead flickers frantically, as if struggling to once again contain the Mania outside, but each attempt is torn apart by the howling sand and wind.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No way! We can't fight these things! Run... Wait, what?!

Hella turns around, shocked to see that most of the residents aren't retreating. Instead, they're grabbing whatever they can find—pots, pans, and other utensils—as makeshift weapons, apparently preparing to join the fight.

steps.speaker: Rosse
steps.content: Everyone who can still move, follow me! Gear up! We can't let them keep destroying the barrier!
Someone hauls the Aurum Secretum device off Hella's hands. People rush past her, many pausing to ruffle her hair before charging unflinchingly into the chaos.
Another violent tremor shakes the earth. Dust rains down as deep fissures crack through Furor's rocky surface, cutting straight into the underground depths.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: Those guys? They were probably taken underground. There's a special place down there where bad people get locked up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh no...! Horo!!

The situation is dire, and the Legion is still trapped underground. This is the perfect opportunity Hella has been waiting for. With everyone distracted by the chaos, no one will notice if she slips away. She can rescue the Legionnaires and they can all escape together.
But...

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: Don't worry! You're one of us now. Those DisCity thugs won't ever get to hurt you again!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sorry, but my friends are waiting for me. I have to go now...!
Screams and sobs echo throughout the city. Squeezing her eyes shut in anguish and gritting her teeth, Hella runs toward the underground cell with her head down.
The ground shakes violently once again. Nearby, Granny Nysa pulls the trembling little Zade into her arms, whispering a prayer with her rosary gripped tightly in her hands.

steps.speaker: Granny Nysa
steps.content: Oh dear, oh dear... Don't be afraid, little one. It'll all be over soon...
Not expecting this turn of events, you rub your temples in exasperation.
Several sand beasts break through the defenses, riding the sandy winds. Hearing the child's cries, they turn and charge toward the pair!
But seconds pass, and the expected pain never comes. Someone has blocked the beasts' attack.
The petite girl snatches a pipe from the rubble and positions herself protectively in front of them.

steps.speaker: Zade
steps.content: Hella!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You want them? You'll have to get through me first!
